nusmp.page.book_gravity.heavy_infighting: Heavy Infighting: Gladiator - three slams in a row on one foe within 8 blocks, 8 x EP scale each; the ground answers every one and they stay pinned and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.evil_gods_pressu: Evil God's Pressure Craft - a rock is pulled out of the ground in front of you and compressed into a great sword. It rises, turns to where you aim and is launched: 26 x EP scale along its path, ignoring 30 percent of armour, piercing.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.lightened_step: Lightened Step - you and the allies within 4 blocks have gravity lowered for 8 s: slow falling, a high leap and a lighter run.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.weighted_blows: Weighted Blows - for 15 s the weight on your fists and weapon is raised: melee blows land 40 percent (+5 percent per EP step) harder and press the foe into the ground.
nusmp.page.book_gravity.gravity_sphere: Gravity Sphere - a singularity orb flies from your hand: 11 x EP scale damage, a heavy slow and a pull down on what it hits, and a crush where it ends.
